sentences.en: Didn't you remove them from the premises some years ago?
sentences.zh: 你不是几年前就把它们从公司里移除了吗？

sentences.en: He told me that dogs weren't allowed on their premises.
sentences.zh: 他告诉我他们的场所不允许带狗。

sentences.en: Life is the art of drawing sufficient conclusions from insufficient premises.
sentences.zh: 生活就是从不足的前提中得出足够结论的艺术。

senses.zh: 引出，预先提出；作为…的前提 -
前提；上述各项；房屋连地基 -
